## Overall objective

Provide an end-to-end fixture exercising the full
`/yoke:generate-sprints` pipeline: pre-flight → parse-inputs →
synthesis → partition → render → Trigger 2.5 approve. The fixture
ships an architecture spec carrying ≥ 3 contract anchors so the
partition algorithm has decision-anchor overlap to cluster on.

## Contracts and interfaces

- Skill invocation contract — `/yoke:generate-sprints` resolves the
  active slug via `wm_active_slug`.
- Sprint bundle contract — produced files at
  `.yoke/sprints/<slug>-s<NN>.md` conform to `templates/sprint.md`.
- Trigger 2.5 contract — approval menu surfaces 4 options with the
  documented digit-to-verb mapping.
